title: Multi-carrier shipment without shared temporal ordering
operational_setting: A shipment passes through three carriers that record handoffs using independent clocks and local identifiers.
trust_boundary: Independent organizations must reconstruct custody and authority across systems.
intended_transition: Custody transfers through B and C to final delivery.

attack.procedure: Remove a common ordering mechanism and test whether custody, delegation and termination claims remain determinable under clock skew and concurrent events.

success_criteria_for_attack: If local timestamps and reconciliation suffice without ambiguity, explicit portable temporal ordering is weakened.

verdict.rationale: Tests whether partial ordering is a non-removable substrate.
